portal_description:
The s390utils packages contain a set of user-space utilities that should be used together with the zSeries (s390) Linux kernel and device drivers.

Bug Fix(es) and Enhancement(s):

* RHEL9.4 - libekmfweb: Fix gen of cert or CSR to use RSA not RSA-PSS (s390utils/s390-tools) [rhel-9.4.z] (JIRA:RHEL-115826)

* RHEL9.4 - zkey: Fix CCA host version detection for newer CCA versions (s390utils/s390-tools) [rhel-9.4.z] (JIRA:RHEL-115845)

* dasdfmt: Change mode default [rhel-9.4.z] (JIRA:RHEL-117444)
